design_defects_exposed.required_resolution: Use a separately encrypted, provider-scoped, short-lived deletion handle or an immediate durable deletion job. Never weaken the content-free receipt into a raw provider-ID store.
Replace the single mutually exclusive terminal event with orthogonal operational-closure and residual-retention facts or an exact compound event.
Add a remediation path that preserves the failed evidence without allowing the erasure workflow to report completion.
